app.title: Access control
app.intro: Rules are the vocabulary, owners hold them, inheritance passes them on.
app.noScreens: Every screen is switched off in config/accessUi.php.
app.problems: Some configured entities could not be used:
rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: The names code checks against. Rules of code come and go with migrations; the panel changes how they read and where they sit. Rules made here are for names code builds at run time.
rules.guardNameHint: What code asks for. Dots place it in the tree.
rules.optionSpecHint: Empty for a plain rule. A validation rule, such as in:csv,pdf, makes every value a permission of its own.
rules.readOnlyNotice: Rules are read-only in this installation. They change through migrations.
rules.confirmDelete: Delete this rule for good? Its children move up one level. This cannot be undone.
owners.title: Owners
owners.intro: The records that hold permissions. Open one to set what it may do, or where it takes its rights from.
owners.name: Name
owners.nameHint: What administrators read. Free to change.
owners.identifierHint: The machine name migrations and seeders refer to. It cannot be changed afterwards.
owners.notManagedHint: This type is not listed in config/accessUi.php. It is shown because it holds a permission of its own.
owners.confirmDelete: Delete this owner record? Its permissions and assignments go with it, and its heirs lose what it held. The user or group it stands for stays. This cannot be undone.
permissions.intro: What this owner holds, rule by rule: its own rows and what reaches it from others.
inherit.title: Inheritance
inherit.intro: Who inherits from whom. An inheritor keeps taking whatever the source holds, as the source changes.
inherit.pickSource: Pick a source on the left.
inherit.indirectHint: Reached through another link. Remove the direct one to drop it.
inherit.confirmRemove: Remove this link? Everything it was handing over is lost.
widget.title: Assigned access
rules.inUseNotice: The rule cannot be deleted while somebody holds it. Take these permissions away first.
rules.origin.codeHint: Created and removed by migrations. Title, description, place in the tree and options are open here.
rules.origin.customHint: Made in this panel for a name code builds at run time. Every field is open.
rules.origin.importHint: Named by an imported document and not yet claimed by code. Every field is open.
rules.managedNotice: Comes with code. The name, the model and the condition stay as the code was written; a migration changes them.
rules.resourceNone: no model: the rule is not about a record
rules.resourceHint: The model conditions of this rule read, by its alias in config access.resources.
rules.ruleConditionHint: For every holder of the rule, on top of the conditions of their own rows. For facts about the record itself.
owners.tenantHint: A tenant type: owners inheriting from it get its id into user.tenant.
owners.guestHint: Requests without a user are checked as this owner. Signed-in users do not get its permissions on top of their own.
owners.heirsHint: Everyone that inherits from this owner, at any depth. A change here reaches all of them.
permissions.treeNote: config access.rule_tree_inheritance is on: a row on a rule also reaches the rules below it in the tree, shown here as "through" that rule.
rules.selfHint: The suffix .self: the row applies to the records this owner created.
permissions.priorityNote: From the weakest: inherited permit, inherited prohibition, own permit, own prohibition. A row with a condition decides per record; the state column then says so.
permissions.conditionalHint: The strongest rows carry conditions. Ask "Why?" for one record.
permissions.withConditionHint: A permit or a prohibition with an option value and a condition
permissions.conditionHint: Leave empty for a plain row. A row with a condition applies to the records it is true for.
conditions.hint: Text of a condition, checked while you type. Empty means no condition.
conditions.aggregatesCost: count, sum, min, max and exists over a relation cost a subquery per row of a list.
explain.title: Why?
explain.intro: Every permission that takes part in one check, strongest first, the one that decided, and what its condition read.
explain.recordHint: alias:id for one record, alias for records of that kind in general, empty for a check without a record.
explain.staleCache: The cached permissions disagree with the database. The check answers from the cache; flush it on the Health screen.
health.title: Health
health.intro: Stored conditions, rules and owners against the models and config of today. Run it after a migration.
health.fixHint: Saves again the conditions whose column types changed since they were saved.
health.flushHint: For changes made past the panel, straight in the tables. The panel turns the cache over by itself.
health.allGood: Everything stored matches the models and config of today.
xacml.title: XACML
xacml.intro: Export the permissions as an XACML 3.0 policy, or look at what a document would change before importing it.
xacml.fileHint: An export of this package, or an XACML 3.0 policy of another system.
xacml.hasErrors: Parts of the document do not convert. Nothing is written while these stand, unless you choose a partial import.
xacml.nothingToChange: The document and the database say the same.
xacml.replace: Replace what differs with the document
xacml.replaceWarning: {count} row(s) of the database will be overwritten by the document. An import never deletes what the document lacks.
xacml.partial: Import what converts, although parts do not
xacml.partialWarning: A prohibition that did not convert is left out, and access becomes wider than the document meant.
xacml.confirmImport: Import the document into the database? Rows are created inside one transaction; what differs is replaced only if you chose so.
widget.ownHint: Rows granted to this account itself.
widget.inheritedHint: Rows that reach this account through what it inherits from.
widget.conditionalHint: Rows with a condition: whether they apply is decided per record.
permissions.byOptionHint: Granted value by value; the rows say which values.
rules.parentHint: Grouping in the list. With config rule_tree_inheritance off, the place changes nothing for a check.
rules.howItReads: How it reads in the panel
permissions.ruleConditionApplies: The condition of the rule applies on top of this row.
permissions.ownRows: Rows of this owner on the rule
permissions.noOwnRows: Nothing of its own on this rule yet.
permissions.changeRowHint: Saving replaces the row. Another effect or value makes it a different row; the old one is removed.
permissions.viaTreeHint: A row on a rule above in the tree; config rule_tree_inheritance passes it down. Change it on that rule.
